_comment: Optional yt-dlp search sources per music folder (FOLDER-DERIVED model). NOTE: crates are AUTO-DISCOVERED at runtime from non-empty folders under MUSIC_DIR (see azuracast.discover_music_crates) — this file does NOT decide what's on air. It is only read by scripts/fetch_trending.py for optional yt-dlp ytsearch queries, which is currently dormant. To source a folder via YouTube search instead of an Anghami playlist, add queries here and run fetch_trending.py for that crate. Folder keys MUST match config/schedule_config.py.
